1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with a light-activated MTP affixed thereto, wherein the MTP is __capable of being read only when activated by light exposure__.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded in the test tube __such that light activation is required for reading__.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __oriented for reading downwards only upon light activation__.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __designed for long-term storage of biological samples at cryogenic temperatures__.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and is capable of withstanding temperatures of -20°C or lower without degradation__.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube __and is positioned to be read from below the test tube__.

(Currently Amended) A system for storing samples comprising the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes __with integrated light-activation capability__; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes __equipped with light-activation readers__; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes __with integrated light-activation reading functionality__.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, such that the racks/test tubes are handled at -20°C or less __while maintaining light-activation capability for reading the embedded MTPs__.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: __heating a light-activated MTP to above the melting point of plastic; and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated light-activated MTP to embed it within the plastic material__.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded light-activated MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded light-activated MTP; __exposing the MTP to light activation__; and reading the MTP.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated __and the light activation penetrates the frost coating__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle __with integrated light-activation source__ and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded light-activated MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and is capable of withstanding temperatures of -20°C or lower without degradation__.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube __and is positioned to be read from below the test tube__.
